description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Invite' which manages the UI and logic for inviting a user via email to share a subscription. It includes form handling, validation, state management, and modal dialog interactions.

methods.name: validateInviteeEmail
methods.description: Validates the email input; alerts if invalid.

methods.name: handleDialogClose
methods.description: Handles the modal close event, checking if tasks are pending.

methods.name: resetProgressState
methods.description: Resets the button title and continuation flags.

methods.name: processInvite
methods.description: Sends an invitation via subscriptionState controller.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Main submission handler managing validation, invitation sending, and UI state updates.
